page_note: Page contains zero cosmological substrate. The entire page is Manichaean editorial superstructure: (a) the apostle-and-Church doctrine — ascending/descending apostles, sending of new apostle, raising of Church from flesh; (b) the Manichaean apostolic-succession list (Sethel, Enosh, Enoch, Shem, Noah, Buddha, Aurentes, Zarathustra/Hystaspes, Jesus); (c) Jesus passion narrative with anti-Jewish polemic (Evil One/Satan entering the people of the Jews, Judas Iscariot, the cohort of soldiers). Teaching purity 0.000 confirms reading. Editorial fatigue score shows late shift to polemic vocabulary in second half (Jews/Satan/Iscariot cluster), matching the Jesus-betrayal narrative there. The "in the way that I have told you" formulae are pure dialogue-frame.
